9. The business scope of China Status includes:

(a) Building services (屋宇裝備)  
(b) Ventilation systems  
(c) Fire service electrical installations  
(d) Plumbing and waterworks installations (水喉設施)

10. China Status **does not undertake works relating to water tanks, as such works involve concrete works and require specialised expertise that China Status does not have**.

(C) Personnel of China Status

Myself  
11. I am one of the five directors. I hold approximately 30% of the shares.

12. My responsibilities include:

(a) Preparing and submitting tenders;  
(b) Issuing quotations;  
(c) Planning works under the Fire Safety (Buildings) Ordinance (Cap. 572);  
(d) Arranging annual inspections;  
(e) Applying for Shut Down Notices (“**SDN**”) (消防裝置關閉通知書) for China Status or other Registered Fire Service Installation Contractors;  
(f) Liaising with government departments, including the Buildings Department; and  
(g) Attending site inspections, particularly for works under Cap. 572, in order to prepare quotations and drawings.
